text: Our sister Susie's married. And when she isn't sewing shirts, she's sewing other things. Then little sister Molly says, oh, sister's bought a dolly. She's making all the clothes for it with pretty bows and strings. Says Susie, don't be silly. And she blushes and she sighs. Then mother smiles and whispers with a twinkle in her eyes. Sister Susie's sewing.
